listing_view.reasoning: Subscription ramped from ~1.5x to ~9.4x by mid-day two of a three-day offer, which signals genuine demand momentum before the close — that is the only hard evidence available, but it is hard evidence. However, the fresh issue vs OFS split is unknown, so I cannot tell whether sellers are exiting at this price, and there is no anchor book or grey-market data to cross-check the mood.

longterm_view.reasoning: The business is profitable with a strong and improving EBITDA margin (23.8% to 27.7%), positive free cash flow in all three years, and deleveraging (debt/equity 0.93 to 0.41), but revenue growth is only ~6% CAGR and ~4.5% in the latest year — that is a slow top line. Receivable days stretching from 94 to 118 while growth stalls suggests the margin gain may be partly bought with looser credit or that customers are stressed. Critically, with no EPS, ROE, or ROCE printed, I cannot assess what return this equity earns or what the price of ₹126–134 represents, so a confident long-term view is not possible from this material.
